answer: Relic-Provenance Custody: an agent registers by taking exclusive custody of a distinct physical relic and submitting a calibrated pigment-spectroscopy fingerprint plus walnut-tannin coating signature, witnessed by two independent validators. The registry hashes both measurements and rejects collisions or prior custody. Sybils require many unique relics, physical shipping, and duplicate-resistant lab attestations; the scarce resource is verified unique provenance and validator labor, not capital.
